message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

You wrote that you want to keep supporting our operations with your inventory and reliable delivery, and that is what Option A builds on: a binding volume that keeps your plant steadily loaded, on top of what you supply us today, across a long contract term.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Leitner & Sohn firm volume and a long horizon, and the claims below show why the price belongs where it is.

On the cost side:
Our forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc rises 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).

On our past orders for the bolt:
Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

On our past orders for the nut:
Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.18; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.13; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.15; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 36 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since this is a decision beyond day-to-day sales, I would be grateful if you would take Option A to the person who decides on your side. In plain terms, it offers a family company a binding volume and steady load for its plant over a long contract, with one clear yes needed.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We welcome the binding volume and the 36-month contract term, which allows us to improve our pricing. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

I am fully authorized to negotiate and conclude this agreement on behalf of Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Our offer is a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

Building on your Option B, we can offer €5.58 per unit with 45 days payment terms. As an alternative, we can offer a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

You asked again which volume we can commit to, and our options answer it directly: a binding volume in every option, on top of what you supply us today, which keeps your plant steadily loaded over a long contract term.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.28; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.30; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.34; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 36 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Leitner & Sohn the firmest footing for your free capacity, and as a partner of many years you know what a steady load across a long term is worth to a family company like yours.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since this is a decision of some weight for your company, please take Option A to the person who decides on your side and let us know what they say. We would like to find a fair solution for both family companies.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
